    matrix = case['matrix']
    idf = case['idf']
    vector = case['vector']
    nrows = len(matrix)
    ncols = len(idf)
    degree = []
    result = []

        row = matrix[i]
        deg = sum(row)
        weighted = sum(row[j] * idf[j] for j in range(ncols))
        res = weighted * vector[i]
        degree.append(deg)
        result.append(res)
    return {'degree': degree, 'result': result}
